goal: Preserve block-relay-only anchor connections across restarts when a node is shut down with networking disabled
Prevent overwriting anchors with an empty list or dropping them offline to maintain eclipse attack resilience
agreement: Strong support with substantive reviews and no open objections
Verified eclipse mitigation resilience across restarts (willcl-ark, danielabrozzoni)
Verified by testing three connection scenarios before and after changes (naiyoma)
Nonblocking suggestion: skip open-connection loop while inactive to avoid extra addrman calls (naiyoma)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes anchor connection loss when nodes shut down or run while offline
Retains partition-resistance protections against eclipse attacks on reboot
